title: Defence Ministers Press for Patriot Interceptors for Ukraine at Foreign Affairs Council
detail: EU defence ministers met in Brussels under High Representative Kaja Kallas to discuss military support for Ukraine, hybrid threats, the Middle East situation and defence procurement. Discussion centred on urgently needed air-defence interceptors, EUMAM Ukraine training, cooperation between Ukrainian and European defence manufacturers, and curbing Russia's shadow fleet. Kallas appealed to states holding Patriot interceptors to release them to Ukraine immediately while replacements are manufactured.

title: EU Sanctions 10 Individuals and 17 Entities Over Deportation of Ukrainian Children
detail: The Council imposed asset freezes on a further 10 individuals and 17 entities responsible for the systematic unlawful deportation and forcible transfer of Ukrainian children to Russia and within occupied territories, and for their forced assimilation through indoctrination and militarised education. Listed are Tatarstan head Rustam Minnikhanov, the Moscow City Tourism Committee, Russian children's recreation companies and North Korea's Songdowon International Children's Camp.
